meta.name: elevenlabs-tts
meta.description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech via inference.sh: Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo (newest, most expressive, audio tags, realtime streaming), Eleven v3, Multilingual v2 and Flash v2.5, each as its own app with 22+ premium voices. Capabilities: text-to-speech, realtime text-to-speech streaming, audio tags for emotion and delivery, voice selection, stability control, custom and cloned voices. Use for: voiceovers, audiobooks, video narration, podcasts, voice agents, accessibility, IVR. Triggers: elevenlabs, eleven labs, eleven v4, eleven v4 turbo, eleven v3, elevenlabs tts, premium tts, realtime tts, streaming tts, professional voice, ai voice, high quality tts, multilingual tts, voice generation, natural speech, realistic voice, voice over, speech synthesis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
